title: GenomicsChain Tier-2 Code-Reading Adjudication Record
description: Synoptis evidence manifest for a signed Tier-2 (code-reading) adjudication. Same recording path as tier1_report and tier3_verdict: a proof on the anchor, no separate chain. The record carries identities and counts only — the adjudication body and the scan stay with the operator, bound here by adjudication_digest and codescan_evidence_digest. It is a self_reported PROPOSAL: stage_transition.applied is always false, because the Tier-1 rubric makes human sign-off mandatory before a stage transition. The interpreter that produced the adjudication is part of the record because the code-reading tier is deterministic per interpreter, not across interpreters (measured 2026-09-09).

subject_ref.description: The paper, e.g. doi:10.1101/2024.06.17.598857. The code is identified by the evidence digest and, when stated, by repository.

tier1_report_content_hash.description: report_content_hash of the Tier-1 report that was read against the code. Copied from the adjudication (which copied it from the report); binds this record to a specific Tier-1 report.

codescan_evidence_digest.description: sha256 over (path, content-sha256) of every file the scanner read. A re-scan of the same bytes reproduces it.

adjudication_digest.description: Canonical-JSON sha256 of the gc_tier2_adjudicate output as submitted. Recomputed server-side.

declared_lock.description: Lever 1 at threshold `versioned`: an exact conda version or a container tag is present.

byte_fixed_lock.description: Lever 1 at threshold `immutable`: a lock whose bytes are named by their own hash.

in_code_db_pin_classA.description: Lever 2: every external resource the code names is class A.

toolchain.description: Interpreter that produced the scan. Part of the signed identity (toolchain_ruby).

repository.description: OPTIONAL. The checkout that was scanned, as stated by the operator (the scanner reads no .git). Signed when present.
